base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a cavernous chamber so comprehensively grey that even the shadows are grey, with a reinforced steel cage at its centre. Lighting: cold flat grey light, a single spotlight on the cage.
In the shot: Duggie, an enormous, lovable Golden Retriever with shining coin-gold fur smeared with bog mud and river silt, one blade of grass stuck to his head, extraordinarily long floppy ears that flap like wings, huge soulful golden-brown eyes, a giant wagging tail, and a small swarm of cartoon flies circling his head in tight synchronised formation; twelve small red squirrels with enormous bushy tails, wide anxious eyes, and the look of creatures absolutely ready to bite something.
Camera: Slow-motion heroic low angle.
Action: Duggie advances toward the cage in extreme slow motion, ears floating heroically; his paw lands with slow-motion weight and inside the cage the squirrels' eyes widen with hope.
Dialogue: Duggie (goofy, warm, slightly gravelly young male voice; in FAST mode a breathless machine-gun stutter of words; in SLOW mode a deep, stretched, slowed-down drawl as if recorded at quarter speed, SLOW mode, heroic) says: "I... will... save... you... little... friends..."
Sound effects: slow-motion thud, wind, ambience of low hum, squirrel chittering echoing.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
